integrity: Exact finite mod-three boundary computations and a sixty-term positive certificate independently replayed; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The finding concerns the natural transpose action on degree-two integral torsion of the ordinary 5-by-5 chessboard complex, not a classification of larger boards or the entire quotient homology. The integral torsion group is imported from published results; the attached exact finite-field certificate proves the character.
title: Transposition reverses the first three-torsion class of the chessboard complex
